title: Demonstration of transport in an ion trap design for two-dimensional lattices
summary: Microfabricated ion trap chips are at the core of some of the most advanced quantum computers. How a large number of ions is arranged and controlled on an ion trap chip depends on the chosen trap architecture. One such architecture is the quantum spring array (QSA). In the QSA architecture, ion chains are arranged in a two-dimensional lattice and interact with ion chains in neighboring sites in the radial and axial directions of the respective chain.
